strings.events.mtaDelay.title: Train delays
strings.events.mtaDelay.body: The train is 'experiencing delays.' You are experiencing main-character suffering.
strings.events.mtaDelay.wait.result: Twenty-five minutes later it pulls in like nothing happened. Classic.
strings.events.mtaDelay.walk.result: You walked it. Calves of steel, mood actually up.
strings.events.mtaDelay.slice.result: Folded slice on the station stairs. Honestly? A vibe.
strings.events.rentHike.title: Rent hike
strings.events.rentHike.body: Landlord slid a note under the door: new 'amenity fee.' The amenity is a broken buzzer.
strings.events.rentHike.pay.result: Paid. Your wallet is in mourning.
strings.events.rentHike.haggle.result: You pulled out the lease and talked numbers. Fee cut, dignity intact.
strings.events.rentHike.ignore.result: Out of sight. Not quite out of mind.
strings.events.freePizza.title: Free pizza alert
strings.events.freePizza.body: Somebody's birthday party over-ordered. Free slices on the counter, no questions asked.
strings.events.freePizza.grab.result: Free pizza hits different. Happy birthday, stranger.
strings.events.freePizza.pass.result: You walked past free pizza. Discipline? Or chaos?
strings.events.clubPromoter.title: Promoter on the block
strings.events.clubPromoter.body: Promoter at the door says you've got the look. A spot on the list, or some cash to push flyers. Your call.
strings.events.clubPromoter.flyers.result: Flyers gone, cash in pocket. Hustler energy.
strings.events.clubPromoter.list.result: You danced until the DJ played the last track. The whole floor saw you.
strings.events.clubPromoter.pass.result: Early night. Your bed is undefeated.
strings.events.viralMoment.title: Viral moment
strings.events.viralMoment.body: Somebody filmed you mid-moment and the clip is taking off. The algorithm is about to eat.
strings.events.viralMoment.post.result: Posted. Notifications won't stop. Your name's starting to ring.
strings.events.viralMoment.keep.result: Lowkey legend behavior. You know what you did.
strings.events.phoneGrab.title: Scooter snatch attempt
strings.events.phoneGrab.body: Somebody on a scooter went for your phone like it was a drive-through window.
strings.events.phoneGrab.hold.result: Iron grip. He rolled off with nothing but regret.
strings.events.phoneGrab.yell.result: You yelled 'NOT TODAY.' He wobbled, almost wiped out, and scooted off in shame.
strings.events.pickpocket.title: Sticky fingers
strings.events.pickpocket.body: Packed platform, quick hand, lighter pocket. Somebody's trying it.
strings.events.pickpocket.shrug.result: Gone. You're out a few bucks and a little faith in humanity.
strings.events.pickpocket.chase.result: You chased him the length of the platform. He dropped your cash and vanished up the stairs. Legend.
strings.events.bridgeGoldenHour.title: Golden hour
strings.events.bridgeGoldenHour.body: Brooklyn Bridge at golden hour. The algorithm is about to eat.
strings.events.bridgeGoldenHour.photo.result: Posted. The likes are rolling in.
strings.events.bridgeGoldenHour.view.result: No phone, just vibes. Main character, peaceful edition.
strings.events.parkBusker.title: Park session
strings.events.parkBusker.body: Busker with a guitar and big dreams asks the crowd: 'Who knows the chorus?'
strings.events.parkBusker.sing.result: You took the chorus and the crowd went off. Somebody's filming.
strings.events.parkBusker.tip.result: You dropped a tip in the case. Supporting the arts, respect.
strings.events.parkBusker.walk.result: Not your song. You keep it moving.
strings.events.touristPhoto.title: Tourist needs a photographer
strings.events.touristPhoto.body: A tourist hands you their phone: 'Can you get all of us AND the skyline?'
strings.events.touristPhoto.help.result: Nailed the angle. They're calling you a New York legend.
strings.events.touristPhoto.point.result: You pointed them to the next person. Not your shift.
strings.events.bodegaCat.title: The bodega cat chose you
strings.events.bodegaCat.body: Bodega cat hops on the counter and locks eyes. This is an honor.
strings.events.bodegaCat.scratch.result: Chin scratch accepted. Your blood pressure dropped ten points.
strings.events.bodegaCat.treat.result: Treat secured. You're the cat's favorite now. Probably.
strings.events.blockParty.title: Block party
strings.events.blockParty.body: Somebody closed off the street. Speakers out, grills going, aunties dancing.
strings.events.blockParty.join.result: You ate, you danced, you got adopted by three families. Iconic.
strings.events.blockParty.skip.result: You had places to be. The music followed you for two blocks.
strings.events.downpour.title: Surprise downpour
strings.events.downpour.body: The sky opened up out of nowhere. The weather app is lying again.
strings.events.downpour.umbrella.result: Corner store umbrella secured. It will break by Thursday.
strings.events.downpour.run.result: You ran for it. Soaked to the socks.
strings.events.downpour.wait.result: You waited it out under an awning with six strangers. Bonding.
strings.events.nameMisspelled.title: Who is Jeremiah?
strings.events.nameMisspelled.body: The barista wrote a whole different name on your cup. Who is Jeremiah?
strings.events.nameMisspelled.post.result: Posted the cup. The comments are undefeated.
strings.events.lateNightCart.title: Halal cart at midnight
strings.events.lateNightCart.body: The cart on the corner is still going. White sauce, hot sauce, no regrets.
strings.events.lateNightCart.plate.result: Chicken over rice on the curb. Peak New York.
strings.events.lateNightCart.skip.result: You walked past. Your stomach will remember this.
